content: 1. Taking this medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine ketone tests, potentially leading to inaccurate results. Inform your healthcare provider or laboratory personnel that you are using this medication. 2. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). If the symptoms are less severe, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. 3. While on this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and/or medical tests, such as sputum tests, kidney and liver function tests, uric acid level assessments, and complete blood counts. These tests help monitor your response to the medication and detect any potential side effects. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. 4. If you miss a dose of this medication and you are on a daily dosing schedule, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. If you are on a weekly dosing schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If you do not remember until the next day or later, consult your doctor or pharmacist for guidance on a new dosing schedule. 5. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations or your pharmacist's advice. 6. Before starting this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 7. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medication, as it may increase the risk of liver disease. 8. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. Inform your healthcare provider if you are scheduled to receive any vaccinations. 9. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed, as determined by your healthcare provider. It is also known to pass into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. 10. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 11. The information provided here is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
